hero.bioBrief: Welcome to my academic and research website. I am a PhD researcher working in geotechnical engineering, with a focus on slope stability, landslides, stratigraphic uncertainty, numerical modeling, and artificial intelligence. My research integrates geotechnical engineering, data-driven methods, uncertainty quantification, and advanced numerical approaches to address complex engineering problems.

biography: I am a PhD researcher in Geotechnical Engineering at Warsaw University of Technology, Poland. My research interests include slope stability, rainfall-induced landslides, geotechnical uncertainty, stratigraphic variability, numerical modeling, and artificial intelligence.

My work bridges the gap between traditional geotechnical engineering and cutting-edge data science, utilizing machine learning algorithms, physics-informed AI models, probabilistic methods, and finite element modeling (PLAXIS 2D/3D) to advance landslide risk assessment and reliability-based design.

publications.title: Application of Metakaolin and Cement in the Stabilisation of Expansive Soil: An Experimental Study
publications.abstract: This experimental study evaluates the effect of combining metakaolin and cement additives to improve the engineering properties, swelling potential, unconfined compressive strength, and plasticity of expansive subgrade soils.

publications.title: Reviews on Energy-Piled Raft Foundation Performance and Design
publications.abstract: A comprehensive review examining thermo-mechanical behavior, thermal load transfer mechanisms, combined piled raft foundation (CPRF) interactions, and structural design standards for energy piles.

publications.title: An Artificial Intelligence-Based Data-Driven Method for Predicting Soil Shear Strength
publications.abstract: We propose a physics-informed ensemble machine learning framework to accurately predict soil shear strength parameters (cohesion and friction angle) from standard penetration test (SPT) and CPT field data.

publications.title: Explainable Ensemble Machine Learning Models for Predicting Concrete Compressive Strength
publications.venue: Journal of Materials in Civil Engineering
publications.abstract: Integrating SHAP and LIME interpretability frameworks with XGBoost, CatBoost, and Random Forest algorithms to decode feature importance in high-performance concrete mix design.

publications.title: Numerical Modeling of Rainfall-Induced Slope Failure Considering Stratigraphic Variability
publications.abstract: Finite-element seepage and slope stability analysis in PLAXIS 2D investigating hydraulic hysteresis and pore water pressure development during intense precipitation events.

publications.title: Assessment of Soil Compaction Characteristics Using Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and CatBoost Algorithms
publications.abstract: Predicting Maximum Dry Density (MDD) and Optimum Moisture Content (OMC) of fine-grained soils from index properties using gradient boosted decision trees.

publications.title: Machine Learning-Based Estimation of California Bearing Ratio (CBR) for Subgrade Soils
publications.abstract: Developing non-linear regression and Artificial Neural Network models to estimate soaked and unsoaked CBR values for road subgrade pavement design.

publications.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Subsurface Soil Profile Modeling Using Generalized Coupled Markov Chains
publications.abstract: Stochastic simulation framework utilizing Generalized Coupled Markov Chains (GCMC) to quantify 3D subsurface stratigraphic uncertainty from sparse borehole logging.

publications.title: A Systematic Review of Machine Learning Based Landslide Susceptibility Mapping
publications.venue: Journal of Geotechnical and Infrastructure Engineering
publications.abstract: A systematic survey analyzing machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, SVM, Deep Neural Networks) applied to spatial landslide susceptibility mapping, GIS data conditioning factors, and model validation metrics.

publications.title: Prediction of Road Traffic Accident Severity Using Machine Learning Techniques in the Case of Addis Ababa
publications.venue: 7th EAI International Conference on Robotic Sensor Networks (EAI ROSENET 2024)
publications.abstract: This paper presents machine learning models trained on road infrastructure, traffic volume, and environmental factors to predict traffic accident severity levels and identify high-risk urban road blackspots.

publications.title: Developing a Correlation Model Between the Frequency of Road Traffic Accidents and Road Geometric Design Elements
publications.venue: Journal of Road and Traffic Engineering
publications.abstract: Statistical and regression modeling evaluating how horizontal curvature, gradient, lane width, and shoulder characteristics influence accident rates on mountainous highway corridors.

publications.title: Probabilistic Analysis of Slope Reliability Under Unsaturated Flow Conditions
publications.venue: Georisk: Assessment and Management of Risk for Engineered Systems
publications.abstract: Evaluating reliability index and probability of failure in unsaturated soil slopes under dynamic rainfall infiltration using Response Surface Method and Monte Carlo simulation.

publications.title: Comparative Evaluation of Decision Trees, Random Forest, and ANN in Predicting Subgrade Soil Modulus
publications.venue: International Conference on Infrastructure Resilience & Geotechnics (ICIRG 2024)
publications.abstract: Comparing performance metrics (R2, RMSE, MAE) of supervised learning algorithms for predicting resilient modulus of subgrade soils from physical index properties.

publications.title: Application of Satellite InSAR Data for Landslide Monitoring and Early Warning in Mountainous Corridors
publications.venue: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
publications.abstract: Processing Sentinel-1 Persistent Scatterer InSAR (PSI) displacement time series to monitor active landslide movement velocity along transportation corridors.

publications.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Slope Stability Analysis Under Rainfall Infiltration
publications.abstract: Incorporating Unsaturated Soil Mechanics partial differential equations into deep neural network loss functions to constrain physical consistency in slope safety factor predictions.

publications.title: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of Combined Piled Raft Foundation (CPRF) in Cohesive Soils
publications.abstract: A comprehensive book chapter examining load sharing mechanisms between raft and piles in soft cohesive clays using PLAXIS 3D numerical simulations and field pile load testing.

publications.title: Evaluation of Lime and Fly Ash Treatment on Geotechnical Index Properties of Black Cotton Soil
publications.abstract: Laboratory testing of expansive black cotton soils stabilized with varying percentages of hydrated lime and industrial fly ash, focusing on Atterberg limits, CBR, and free swell index.

publications.title: Geotechnical Hazard Assessment and Risk Mapping using GIS and Remote Sensing Approaches
publications.venue: Springer Geospatial Technology & Natural Hazards Series
publications.abstract: Book chapter presenting spatial multi-criteria decision evaluation (SMCE) and GIS-based landslide hazard zoning methodologies in high-relief mountainous topography.

publications.title: Settlement Analysis and Load Distribution of Piled Rafts Under Eccentric Loading
publications.abstract: 3D finite-element study evaluating differential settlement, tilting, and individual pile load mobilization in non-uniform piled raft foundation configurations under eccentric structural loads.

courses.title: PLAXIS 2D/3D & Numerical Modeling for Slope Stability
courses.subtitle: Master Finite Element Analysis, seepage coupling, slope stability, and structural retention modeling in PLAXIS.
courses.summary: Practical numerical modeling masterclass using PLAXIS 2D/3D for slope stability, rainfall infiltration, and retaining structures.
courses.description: In this masterclass designed by PhD Researcher Semachew Molla Kassa, you will learn the core concepts of numerical modeling in PLAXIS 2D/3D applied to geotechnical engineering, slope stability, groundwater flow, and safety factor calculations.
learningOutcomes: Set up finite-element geometry and material constitutive models in PLAXIS 2D/3D.
Perform transient seepage and rainfall-induced slope stability calculations.
Evaluate Factor of Safety (phi-c reduction method) under complex loading.
Export and post-process deformation and stress outputs for technical reporting.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering principles.

curriculum.title: Module 1: Fundamentals of Finite Element Modeling in Geotechnics
lessons: Introduction to PLAXIS Interface & Mesh Generation
Constitutive Soil Models: Mohr-Coulomb vs. Hardening Soil Model
Boundary Conditions & Initial Pore Water Pressure

curriculum.title: Module 2: Slope Stability & Factor of Safety Calculations
lessons: Stability Analysis of Reinforced Slopes & Soil Nails

curriculum.title: Module 3: Advanced 3D Geotechnical Analysis
lessons: Final Capstone Project: Landslide Stabilization Model
